funnel.note: Signal loss is split roughly evenly: 50.6% recall at override detection AND 48.8% precision at alternative ranking. Both layers contribute equally; once the right model is selected, recovery is deterministic (100%).

propagation_matrix.note: Cross-model cells (E_large->R_medium etc.) require new reasoning calls on cross-model extraction outputs; reported here as design, not results

interpretation: Residual GAP has weak but real learnable signal; safe exploitation requires selective coverage control (5-10% of highest-scoring instances). The prerequisite is that the router score contains weak but non-zero ranking signal; coverage control amplifies this into safe positive GAP Recovery.
evidence_tier_note: 5-10% coverage results come from 5-fold CV + post-hoc risk-coverage analysis on 1600 dev questions. This is mechanism evidence, NOT independent-test-set confirmation. Paper should state: "in cross-validation analysis on development data, GAP Recovery of 7.4-8.6% was observed at 5-10% coverage with 0-1 harmful overrides" rather than claiming stable independent-set recovery.
